body:
## Result

Nicowar currently lets wood encroach on wheat-growing space without issuing clearing orders. Its existing farming scan now marks wood for clearing when it is outside the protected wood zone and either inside the wheat zone or touching wheat on one of four sides. The existing zone predicates remain unchanged (water-gradient distance <6 for wood and <10 for wheat).

The production change is confined to `src/ai/nicowar/Farming.cpp`: 31 added lines and one changed line. It removes conflicting forbidden marks, releases non-wood clearing tiles outside the wood zone on subsequent farming scans, and preserves the one-tile clearing strips around its buildings, including wrapped corners. No new flags, settings, AI members or save fields.

This intentionally changes Nicowar's economy and difficulty: workers can reclaim wheat space, and clearing can compete with other work. The existing wood-zone exemption still applies, including beside wheat. Cleanup uses the existing 250-tick farming cadence; it is not instantaneous when the resource changes. Outside building strips, the farming scan now removes non-wood clearing marks outside the wood zone, including manually painted marks on a shared team.

## Verification

- macOS arm64 release client build passed: `scons -j4 release=1 server=0 build/src/glob2 nicowar-farming-test`.
- Added `NicowarFarmingHarness`, registered in Linux CI and documented in `test/README.md`. It executes actual farming and area orders, checking zone boundaries, four-way adjacency, both map seams, undiscovered tiles, conflicting protection, wheat replacement, cleanup after loss of neighboring wheat, and building perimeter preservation.
- `python3 test/run-savegame-safety-tests.py --check-preferences build/src/NicowarFarmingHarness .` passed. The harness fails against the original `Farming.cpp` with `FAIL: wood cleared throughout wheat-only band`.
- Local smoke: SmallForTwo, seed 42, Nicowar/Nicowar, 4096 ticks completed. A checkpoint at 2048 loaded and completed, but its per-tick checksum records differed from uninterrupted play starting at tick 2048. The same test on unmodified base `fae2f4783` also differed from tick 2048 (2048/2048 records). This pre-existing continuation issue remains outside this small fix; save/resume equivalence is not claimed.

No saved representation, replay acceptance gate, network protocol or order executor changed. Recorded orders still use the existing simulation implementation. Cross-platform checksum equivalence and a human playthrough have not been verified.

### Reproduce the smoke/continuation check

Use an absolute map path and fresh output directories:

```sh
build/src/glob2 --run-game --map-file /absolute/path/to/maps/SmallForTwo.map \
  --game-seed 42 --player nicowar --player nicowar --ticks 4096 \
  --save initial --save every:2048 --save final --replay true \
  --telemetry checksums --output-dir /tmp/nicowar-full
build/src/glob2 --run-game --load-game /tmp/nicowar-full/checkpoint-2048.game \
  --ticks 4096 --save final --replay true --telemetry checksums \
  --output-dir /tmp/nicowar-resumed
```

Use `tick_records()` in `test/tournament_cli_integration.py` to compare the overlapping records in the two `game.replay.checksums` files.

## Review

The human maintainer and original Nicowar author explicitly approved merging this fix in the working session.
title: Clear wood encroaching on Nicowar wheat farms
